mapper.sql: fz.id, fz.laoren_id as laorenId, l.xingming as laorenXingming, fz.zhangdan_yuefen as zhangdanYuefen, fz.chuangwei_fei as chuangweiFei, fz.huli_fei as huliFei, fz.yaopin_fei as yaopinFei, fz.qita_fei as qitaFei, fz.zongjine, coalesce(jf.yijiao_jine, 0) as yijiaoJine, greatest(coalesce(fz.zongjine, 0) - coalesce(jf.yijiao_jine, 0), 0) as weiJiaoJine, case when fz.zhuangtai = '已取消' then '已取消' when coalesce(jf.yijiao_jine, 0) = 0 then '待缴费' when coalesce(jf.yijiao_jine, 0) >= coalesce(fz.zongjine, 0) then '已结清' else '部分缴费' end as zhuangtai, fz.beizhu, fz.shengcheng_shijian as shengchengShijian

from feiyong_zhangdan fz join laoren_xinxi l on fz.laoren_id = l.id left join ( select zhangdan_id, sum(jiaofei_jine) as yijiao_jine from jiaofei_jilu group by zhangdan_id ) jf on fz.id = jf.zhangdan_id
case when fz.zhuangtai = '已取消' then '已取消' when coalesce(jf.yijiao_jine, 0) = 0 then '待缴费' when coalesce(jf.yijiao_jine, 0) >= coalesce(fz.zongjine, 0) then '已结清' else '部分缴费' end
mapper.update: update feiyong_zhangdan set laoren_id = #{laorenId}, zhangdan_yuefen = #{zhangdanYuefen}, chuangwei_fei = #{chuangweiFei}, huli_fei = #{huliFei}, yaopin_fei = #{yaopinFei}, qita_fei = #{qitaFei}, zongjine = #{zongjine}, zhuangtai = #{zhuangtai}, beizhu = #{beizhu} where id = #{id}
